newsitem.title: CANADA: Tarxien says to recommend new Gecamex offer.
newsitem.headline: Tarxien says to recommend new Gecamex offer.

text.p: Tarxien Corp said it has entered an amended agreement with Gecamex Technologies Inc for an increase of its takeover offer to C$15.40 from C$14.10.
Tarxien said the offer will be subject to conditions, including the irrevocable condition that 50.1 percent of the shares will be tendered to the bid, which will expire on or about November 28, 1996.
The company said Tarxien's independent committee will recommend that shareholders of Tarxien accept the offer and reject competing offers from Ventra Group Inc and privately held PaintPlas Inc.

Tarxien also said it has agreed to increase the amount it will pay to Gecamex if the sweetened takeover offer is topped by another bidder. Tarxien said it has agreed to pay Gecamex C$0.50 per Tarxien share to Gecamex if another bidder prevails over Gecamex.

Tarxien has received takeover bids from Paintplas at C$14.50 a share and from Ventra Group Inc, which sweetened its original offer to C$9.25 a share plus Ventra shares and warrants from C$8 a share plus two Ventra shares for each Tarxien share.
